name: cicero-hours-board-tests
description: Dev-only: jsdom harness for the allocation board's browser code.

scripts.test:board:web: node web/build.js --out=/tmp/cicero_shell.html && python3 -c "from tests.synthetic import write_export; from pathlib import Path; write_export(Path('/tmp/cicero_synth.csv'))" && node tests/board_check.js /tmp/cicero_shell.html /tmp/cicero_synth.csv
scripts.test:cross: python3 -c "from tests.synthetic import write_export; from pathlib import Path; write_export(Path('/tmp/cicero_synth.csv'))" && node tests/cross_check.js /tmp/cicero_synth.csv
scripts.test:shell: node web/build.js --out=/tmp/cicero_shell.html && python3 -c "from tests.synthetic import write_export; from pathlib import Path; write_export(Path('/tmp/cicero_synth.csv'))" && node tests/shell_check.js /tmp/cicero_shell.html /tmp/cicero_synth.csv
